name: Ortofrutta
description: Proof of concept for a fruit packing house. Traceability in both directions (from a delivered order back to the raw lots and producers, and from a raw lot forward to the customers it reached) and crews organised production by production. Around them: deliveries weighed into cold-storage cells, the orders of the day, a per-line plan with changeover times and truck deadlines, work sheets costed in €/kg, margins. Runs on simulated data loaded from CSV files. Screens are in Italian and carry the name of the company set when the data is loaded.
author: SEIKA Innovation
